base_model: from-scratch compact tabular transformer (no third-party weights)
training_method: multi-task SFT from scratch, float16 AMP, class-weighted CE

decision.rationale: Real neural artifact trained on GPU (Quadro T2000, fp16, 345,812 params, peak 33.8MB) but it does not add measurable value over the deterministic baseline: TEMPORAL_HOLDOUT route-outcome accuracy 0.0 (deterministic 1.0, hybrid 0.857) and Brier 1.335 under distribution shift with only 69 real evidence rows. Zero hard policy violations. The deterministic production system remains the routing authority; this artifact is experimental and will be retrained as the daily R3 corpus windows accumulate real per-task evidence.
